'''Timon Medon Plaza''' was a plaza in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], named after [[Timon Medon/Legends|Timon Medon]], the Unifier of Utapau. Timon was responsible for uniting the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'ans]] and the [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] together in the early history of Utapau's civilization. The plaza was a large open space dominated by a central spire rising from the rocky ground.

The Timon Medon Plaza was located to the right of the [[Utapau Council Chambers/Legends|Utapau Council Chambers]]. The Utapau Council was directed by Administrator [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]], a descendant of Timon.
